mainEntity.name: What will I learn from this book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Where AI is already being used in artificial intelligence today — and where theory collides with deployment.
Readers who want a grounded, non-technical view of artificial intelligence itself, including AI-curious readers, strategists, students, and anyone trying to separate substance from theatre.
